description: Lollipop chart by Powerviz is a powerful visual that combines a dot and a line to represent data points and their values, providing a clear and simple alternative to bar charts. Ideal for displaying categorical data, the Lollipop chart simplifies complex datasets, making it easier for stakeholders to grasp trends and make informed decisions. This visual offers advanced features such as Error Bars, Custom Markers, Small Multiples, IBCS Templates, Dynamic Deviation, Reference Lines/Bands, 30+ Color Palettes, Preview Sliders, Ranking, Conditional Formatting, Custom Fill Patterns, Annotation, Custom Sorting, and many more. Check out the live demo here. To access all the Advanced Settings, click the gear "⚙️" icon in the top-right corner. Key Feature Highlights: Chart Options: 2 in 1 visual, switch easily between vertical and horizontal chart. Small Multiples: Split your visual into multiple, smaller visuals based on your selected fields. Error Bars: Add error bars to your data points to display variability or uncertainty, enhancing the accuracy of your analysis. Race Chart: Enhance the chart by adding animations to visually show data changes over time. Cut/Clip Axis: Trim or adjust the axis to accommodate the outliers within the same chart.
